windows.command: if ('${input:sistema}' -eq 'Linux') { bash '${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/manage-components-linux.sh' --mode download --wants-agents '${input:quieresAgents}' --wants-skills '${input:quieresSkills}' --wants-readme '${input:quieresReadme}' } else { pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/manage-components.ps1' -Mode download -WantsAgents '${input:quieresAgents}' -WantsSkills '${input:quieresSkills}' -WantsReadme '${input:quieresReadme}' }
